description: Enterprise RateAPI Routes coverage: how many US credit unions RateAPI holds live, verbatim-evidenced membership rules for (and what share of the active fleet that is), how the rules split by kind, how many counties, states and employers they name, verification status, and freshness. The `authority` object distinguishes exact immutable active publications from older graph and flat compatibility records; `evidence_sources` reports the public source mix. Returns a dated `headline` sentence that can be quoted verbatim. Use this BEFORE find_eligible_credit_unions or check_membership_eligibility when the user asks how complete, authoritative, or fresh the eligibility data is. Aggregate only — no institution-level rows; those come from the eligibility tools. Never reports credit data: the rule schema has no condition kind for credit score, income or debt. An institution absent from the graph is undecided, never ineligible.
name: get_eligibility_coverage

outputSchema.description: Fleet-wide membership-eligibility coverage, passed through from the Enterprise RateAPI Routes GET /v1/eligibility/coverage operation. Every count sits next to the stage it belongs to; nothing here is institution-level.

as_of.description: Most recent rule confirmation across the live graph (ISO 8601) — the moment the data last moved.

authority.description: Serving-authority adoption. Exact immutable publications are separated from older graph and flat compatibility records.

active_publication_rules.description: Rules declared by exact active publications.

active_publications.description: Charters governed by an exact immutable active-publication pointer.

flat_only_institutions.description: Active institutions represented only by the lossy flat compatibility record.

legacy_graph_institutions.description: Institutions with live graph rules but no immutable active-publication pointer.

publications_with_proposal_coverage.description: Active publications reporting proposed, verified and withheld claim counts.

selection_bound_publications.description: Active publications carrying selection-bound append-only provenance.

by_kind.description: Live rules and distinct institutions per rule kind, largest first.

institutions.description: Distinct institutions with at least one live rule of this kind.

rule_kind.description: geography | employment | association | education | military | worship | family | household | open | deposit_or_donation | other.

credit_data.description: Explicit statement that no rule condition references credit data.

conditions_referencing_credit.description: Always 0: the condition schema has no kind for credit score, income or debt.

note.description: Plain-language statement of the above, safe to quote.

disclosure.description: Statement that must accompany any consumer-facing use of eligibility data.

evidence_sources.description: Live rule counts by recorded evidence source class; institution counts may overlap.

institutions.description: Distinct institutions with at least one live rule from this source class.

rules.description: Live rules supported by this source class.

source_type.description: Recorded source class, such as membership_page, application_page, ncua or unknown.

fleet.description: The denominator: active institutions and how many the graph holds live rules for.

active_institutions.description: Active US credit unions in the directory.

institutions_with_live_rules.description: Distinct credit unions with at least one live (non-superseded) rule.

generated_at.description: When the aggregate was computed (ISO 8601). Edge-cached for an hour.

headline.description: One dated sentence carrying every headline number next to its denominator. Quote it verbatim.

pipeline.description: Institutions by eligibility pipeline status — why an institution may be absent from the graph (no source found, needs review, pending).

population.description: Population disclosure: graph inventory, not a personal eligibility decision or reachable-offer count.

fleet_scope.description: Institution population used for the fleet denominator.

is_personal_eligibility_decision.description: False: this aggregate is never a decision about a person.

is_reachable_offer_count.description: False: this is never a count of proven suitable offers.

observation_time_semantics.description: Why the newest confirmation is not the age of every rule.

rule_scope.description: Rule population included in the inventory.

reach.description: How specific the rules are: distinct places and organizations named, and institutions carrying each path type.

counties_named.description: Distinct county keys in live, non-negated conditions.

employers_resolved.description: Distinct canonical organizations named by employment conditions.

institutions_open_to_anyone.description: Institutions with a live open_to_anyone condition (passes a two-vendor gate, so deliberately few).

institutions_with_county_rules.description: Institutions with at least one live county-level condition.

institutions_with_employer_rules.description: Institutions with at least one resolved employment condition.

institutions_with_military_rules.description: Institutions with a live military-affiliation condition.

institutions_with_school_rules.description: Institutions with a live student/alumni/school-employee condition.

institutions_with_worship_rules.description: Institutions with a live place-of-worship condition.

states_with_county_rules.description: Distinct states those county keys belong to.

rules.description: Live rule counts, verification split and freshness.

auto_validated.description: Live rules machine-validated against a second independent read.

confirmed_within_30d.description: Live rules confirmed within the last 30 days.

human_verified.description: Live rules verified by a person or the institution.

median_age_days.description: Median days since each live rule was last confirmed.

with_verbatim_evidence.description: Equals live by construction: a rule cannot be stored without its evidence quote.

semantics.description: How to read the counts: live rules only; absence from the graph is undecided, never ineligible; where row-level verdicts live.
